column3: Handheld phone video in a backyard, a small propeller plane passes overhead from left to right, engine sound rising and falling, birds, wind.
Handheld phone video on a busy city street, a jet airliner passes low overhead from left to right, loud jet engine roar rising and falling, traffic noise, realistic ambient sound.
Quiet park in the afternoon, people walking, birds chirping, light wind in the trees, handheld phone video, realistic ambient sound.
Static camera in an open wheat field at golden hour, a small single-engine propeller plane flies low over the field from right to left, the engine sound grows louder then fades, wind in the grass.
Beach at midday, waves rolling in, a passenger jet flies over the beach on approach to an airport, camera tilts up to follow it.
Busy city street sidewalk, cars and buses passing, footsteps, distant voices, handheld phone video with natural street sound.
View from an apartment balcony over rooftops, a propeller airplane passes overhead, engine sound rising and falling as it passes, distant city hum.
Open grass field on a windy day, strong gusts of wind blowing the grass, static camera, wind noise.
Handheld video in a suburban park, a twin-engine propeller plane flies across the sky.
Backyard garden in summer, bees buzzing around flowers, birds singing, a lawn sprinkler hissing, handheld video.
Airport perimeter fence, a large jet airliner takes off and climbs over the camera, jet engine sound rising and falling, phone video.
Ocean beach at sunset, waves crashing, seagulls calling, static camera on the sand, natural sound.
Countryside road, a small propeller crop-duster plane flies low over the road toward and past the camera.
Residential street at night, a cat crosses the road, crickets chirping, a distant dog barks, handheld phone video, natural ambient sound.
Rooftop terrace in a city, friends chatting, a commercial jet flies overhead high in the sky, engine rumble rising and falling.
Forest path in autumn, leaves rustling in the wind, a small stream flowing, birds, static camera, natural sound.
Lakeside dock in the morning, a seaplane with a propeller engine flies low over the lake past the camera, engine sound rising and falling.
Countryside highway shoulder, cars and trucks drive past the camera at speed, tire noise and engine sounds, handheld phone video.
Rainy afternoon on a covered porch, steady rain falling on the garden, light thunder in the distance, static camera, natural sound.
Village square with a fountain, children playing, church bells far away, pigeons, handheld phone video, natural ambient sound.
